lines.x: If you entrust these tasks to me, I can complete all of them in thirteen minutes and seven seconds.
To deepen my understanding of Laterano, study is indispensable. Dr.{@nickname}, please continue your lessons.

I had not expected a school in Laterano to have so many capable engineers. The mechanics club's Closure, in particular, has remarkably novel ideas. If I adjust my systems as she suggests, my output firepower could reach—What? I must absolutely not listen to her?

So the residents of Laterano learn to use firearms or firearm-like weapons from childhood... I am curious what considerations lie behind that. In the next armament class, I intend to observe everyone's training methods closely.

I have thoroughly studied the tactical handouts distributed in class. Please consider allowing me to conduct joint drills with the intelligent work platform THRM-EX. By my calculations, this would raise THRM-EX's output by at least 528%.

While reading a biography of the Blood Knight, I learned of a disease called "Oripathy." I am told that Laterano once refused to let the infected settle there, but that this is no longer the case. Amiya says you know a great deal about the matter. Would you tell me more?
None of the students at school have questioned my identity. They all take me for an eccentric enthusiast of firearm modification. As an infiltration assignment, I would call this smooth progress.

In the dorm lounge I found knight novels and ninja films left behind by our seniors, and I have watched and read them all. Doctor, where can one see a knight fight a ninja? I find it most intriguing... Rhincodon? What sort of place is that?

I have learned that there are students at the school who suffer from Oripathy as well. Though they carry an incurable illness, they face their lives in earnest—studying hard for the future, and enjoying their time after class. I believe that is a display of great strength.
Doctor, have you entered power-saving mode?
A pleasure to meet you. I am Aigis. From today I will be acting alongside all of you. I look forward to working with you.
Laterano's books and recordings are remarkably abundant. I find them deeply interesting. Please allow me to peruse them freely.
An outstanding student commendation? For me? ...Then I shall accept it gladly.
Thank you for the praise. I shall strive to earn a great deal more of it, so please be prepared.
I will protect everyone in the squad. Please leave it to me.
I have been ordered to serve as leader. Please leave the execution of the operation to me.
Mission start.
Enemies detected ahead. Lock-on complete.
Please give me your orders.
Yes.
Leave it to me.
A good angle.
Persona, engage!
Continuous fire!
Firing!
Full firepower!
A perfect victory. Well done, everyone.
Operation successful. Everything went exactly as planned.
Next time, we can do better.
I will cover the retreat. Everyone, fall back!
Rest is also part of the mission. Well done.
Yes? You called for me?
Thank you for your guidance in my studies. I look forward to your continued instruction.
Arknights.

Happy New Year, Doctor. To be honest, I find Laterano rather curious. One may make a wish at the Reliquary on any day, so why does everyone choose this particular day to go together? ...Ah. If it is so that they may celebrate alongside their friends, then I understand. Thank you.
You've come, Doctor. I was listening to a song said to be popular in Laterano... Have you heard it before? I would like to know what people feel when they hear it. Doctor, would you tell me?

Dr.{@nickname}, today is your birthday. Allow me to offer you my wishes. I understand that a "wish" does not necessarily come true. But people have the capacity to strive toward their wishes, and that is precisely why wishes become reality. Your wish, too, will surely come true one day.

Doctor, congratulations on receiving the Most Popular Teacher award. At the request of ■■■ from the administrative office, I have come to escort you to the special award ceremony. Please do not resist; kindly emerge from your hiding place at once. Can you hear me? Please respond, Doctor.
